end.summary:
Recognised some equal-share shapes and named halves, thirds, and quarters in 2 of 5 unaided attempts.
Used equal group sharing with 12 crayons and identified three equal groups.
Named one quarter as one out of four equal parts for a flag.
Sometimes compared coloured parts with remaining parts instead of the whole; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying equal parts and naming halves, thirds, and quarters using shapes, groups, and fair-sharing examples. Nisha explained the method of making equal groups and correctly connected one quarter with one of four equal parts. They mixed up the whole with the parts left when naming a fraction; this was not yet confirmed corrected by the end. At home, show a paper shape divided into equal parts and ask, “How many equal parts altogether?” before asking for the fraction of one coloured part.
